_description: Predictive FAQ cards surfaced when a user is near a landmark. FAQs answer the questions riders actually ask ('Can I lock my bike here?', 'Is there a toilet?'). Query by location_slug and sort by sort_order.

question.example: Can I bring my bicycle inside Park Güell?

answer.example: No. Bicycles are not permitted inside the ticketed monumental zone. Lock up at the designated Bicipark racks on Carrer d'Olot before the entrance.

sort_order.note: Lower number = shown first. Use increments of 10 (10, 20, 30...) for easy re-ordering.

is_premium.note: true = only visible to paid subscribers. Gate with users.subscription_status == active.

related_logistics_id.note: Optional reference to a logistics document (parking/rules). Used to auto-link a 'Find parking' CTA.
